sloka: पुनरेवाथ तं रामो रथस्थं राक्षसाधिपम्।ललाटे परमास्त्रेण सर्वास्त्रकुशलो रणे ।। ६.१००.३८ ।।
transliteration: punarevātha taṁ rāmo rathasthaṁ rākṣasādhipam।lalāṭe paramāstreṇa sarvāstrakuśalo raṇe ।। 6.100.38 ।।

translations.english: Again Rama, who was skilled in the use of all weapons, pierced that king of Rakshasas seated in the chariot with an excellent missile on the forehead.
